name: site-blocks
description: T-numbered library of website sections and UI patterns in two themes. Look up an ID, open its file, copy the markup inside .tb-demo plus the page <style> rules it uses, and bring the tokens from assets/base.css.

sets.ecommerce: The retail set: catalogue, product, checkout, merchandising, account.

patterns.name: Colour palette
patterns.description: Every design token as a live swatch, named, with its role and both theme values, so you can see what a block is allowed to use.

patterns.name: Font families
patterns.description: The three type roles (display, body, mono) rendered in whichever theme is active, with both themes' families named.

patterns.name: Type scale
patterns.description: Bordered scale table showing the H1 to H3 heading sizes, the body measure, and the tracked eyebrow label.

patterns.name: Buttons
patterns.description: Primary (accent fill), secondary (outline), and the nav install pill.

patterns.name: Eyebrow label
patterns.description: Tracked, uppercase, accent-coloured section label prefixed with //.

patterns.name: Badges & tags
patterns.description: NEW badge, rounded pill tag chips, and the bordered numbered index box.

patterns.name: Status pills
patterns.description: Colour-coded state pills (Added, Changed, Fixed, Shipped, In Progress) for changelog and roadmap.

patterns.name: Status pulse
patterns.description: // SYSTEM ONLINE label with a pulsing green indicator dot.

patterns.name: Accordion
patterns.description: Native details/summary disclosure with an animated +/- marker, as used on the FAQ.

patterns.name: Card
patterns.description: Base card surface: hairline border, recessed fill, accent border and a lift on hover.

patterns.name: TypewriterText + copy card
patterns.description: Terminal-style code card with an accent bar, an npm command, and a copy-to-clipboard button.

patterns.name: Loader (pulse)
patterns.description: Pulsing loader dots in the success and accent colours, a static equivalent of @astroanimate/core/Loader.

patterns.name: Sticky Nav Bar
patterns.description: Top navigation with logo, version dropdown, links, social icons, INSTALL button, and a mobile hamburger.

patterns.name: Split Hero
patterns.description: Two-column homepage hero: status pill, headline, feature list, CTAs on the left; badges + code card on the right; glow video behind.

patterns.name: Page Hero
patterns.description: Eyebrow + headline + lead paragraph over a star-field. The standard top of every interior page.

patterns.name: Status Pill
patterns.description: "// SYSTEM ONLINE" label with a pulsing green Loader. Signals a live state.

patterns.name: Code Block Card
patterns.description: Terminal-style card with an accent bar, a typewriter command, and a copy button.

patterns.name: How It Works
patterns.description: Bordered container with corner accents, an embedded demo video, and a 3-up numbered steps grid.

patterns.name: Comparison Table
patterns.description: Feature-by-feature table contrasting AstroAnimate with alternatives, using check / cross / warn icons.

patterns.name: Performance / Architecture Grids
patterns.description: Icon + stat + caption cards laid out on a hairline grid.

patterns.name: Use-case & Doc-structure Tabs
patterns.description: Tabbed panels that swap content in place to show different scenarios.

patterns.name: Open-source Panel
patterns.description: Two-column block: prose on the left, a stacked key/value badge column (LICENSE, SIZE, RUNTIME) on the right.

patterns.name: Principle / Feature Grid
patterns.description: Numbered cards (01–06) on a hairline grid describing values or features.

patterns.name: Docs Layout
patterns.description: Three-column app shell: collapsible grouped sidebar, centered reading column, right "in this page" TOC.

patterns.name: Right TOC (scroll-spy)
patterns.description: "IN THIS PAGE" rail that highlights the active heading as you scroll.

patterns.name: Component Card Grid
patterns.description: Catalog of components grouped by category, each card with name, NEW badge, description, and subpath import.

patterns.name: Blog Listing
patterns.description: A featured post + side cards, a category filter with search, and a dash-separated post list.

patterns.name: Article Layout
patterns.description: Article header with cover image and author, a sticky table of contents, and a prose body with code blocks, callouts, and comparison tables.

patterns.name: FAQ Accordion
patterns.description: Questions grouped by category, each a native disclosure with an animated +/− marker.

patterns.name: Showcase Grid
patterns.description: Cards with a gradient placeholder thumbnail, tags, name, description, and a visit link.

patterns.name: Changelog Timeline
patterns.description: Vertical timeline with version dots and Added / Changed / Fixed change tags per release.

patterns.name: Roadmap Columns
patterns.description: Status-grouped columns (Shipped, In Progress, Planned, Exploring) of feature cards with status pills.

patterns.name: Support Channels
patterns.description: Grid of channel cards plus a numbered "good bug report" checklist and quick links.

patterns.name: Contact Form
patterns.description: Demo form (no backend) beside a column of contact-method cards.

patterns.name: Final CTA Block
patterns.description: Centered eyebrow + headline + button pair over a star-field, closing a page.

patterns.name: Footer
patterns.description: Five-column footer with newsletter signup and a bottom bar showing a live UTC clock.

patterns.name: Pricing
patterns.description: Three-tier pricing with a highlighted recommended plan, feature lists, and CTAs.

patterns.name: Popup promo
patterns.description: A modal promotion built on the native <dialog> element. It opens over a dimmed backdrop and closes on the ✕ or a backdrop click.

patterns.name: Gallery
patterns.description: A responsive thumbnail grid with hover captions. Click any tile to open it in a lightbox.

patterns.name: Tabs
patterns.description: Tabbed panels that swap content in place. Click a tab to switch.

patterns.name: Folders
patterns.description: A collapsible file tree built from nested <details>. Folders expand and collapse with no JavaScript.

patterns.name: Toggle content
patterns.description: A switch that reveals or hides a block of content. CSS-only, using :has().

patterns.name: FAQ, expanded by default
patterns.description: The accordion pattern with every item open on load (open attribute set). Collapse any you don't need.

patterns.name: Contact form
patterns.description: A labelled form with focus states and a demo submit (no backend attached).

patterns.name: Breadcrumbs
patterns.description: A path trail showing the visitor's location, with the current page un-linked.

patterns.name: Bento grid
patterns.description: Asymmetric mosaic of feature tiles with varying spans, subtle gradients, and a hover lift, in pure CSS.

patterns.name: Infinite marquee
patterns.description: Seamlessly looping chip track from a duplicated row and one CSS keyframe; pauses on hover, frozen for reduced-motion.

patterns.name: Statement / word reveal
patterns.description: Display sentence whose words fade and rise in sequence via staggered CSS delays, with a JS replay button.

patterns.name: Animated stat counters
patterns.description: Three figures that count up on first scroll into view via IntersectionObserver; final values live in the markup.

patterns.name: Sticky scroll-story
patterns.description: Two-column block with a pinned visual card that crossfades as a scroll-spy highlights the active step.

patterns.name: Before / after slider
patterns.description: Two stacked panels split by a draggable divider; a range input drives a CSS variable clip, keyboard-accessible.

patterns.name: Hover-reveal work list
patterns.description: Large project rows that highlight on hover while a gradient thumbnail follows the cursor; degrades without JS.

patterns.name: Command palette (⌘K)
patterns.description: Native dialog overlay opened by button or ⌘K/Ctrl+K with live-filtered grouped results.

patterns.name: Callout / admonition boxes
patterns.description: Four tinted variants (Note, Tip, Warning, Danger) with a left accent rail, an icon, and a label. Pure CSS.

patterns.name: API reference block
patterns.description: Method pill, monospace path, params table, and cURL/JSON tabs that switch on click.

patterns.name: Integration grid
patterns.description: Filter chips above a grid of integration tiles, shown or hidden live by data-category.

patterns.name: Announcement bar
patterns.description: Faux top banner with message, inline link, and ✕ dismiss with demo reset link.

patterns.name: Theme switcher
patterns.description: Segmented System/Light/Dark control that restyles only the sample card below.

patterns.name: “Was this helpful?”
patterns.description: Small docs-footer feedback card that swaps to a thank-you state on vote.

patterns.name: Logo cloud / "trusted by" strip
patterns.description: A muted row of company wordmarks under a small label. Marquees slowly and pauses on hover.

patterns.name: Testimonial wall
patterns.description: A multi-column masonry of quote cards: quote, initials avatar, name and role. Static.

patterns.name: Quote slider
patterns.description: One large rotating testimonial. Prev / next buttons and dots advance it; it also auto-advances every 6s.

patterns.name: Newsletter / waitlist capture
patterns.description: An inline email capture that swaps to a success state on submit; also opens in a native <dialog>.

patterns.name: Video demo modal
patterns.description: A 16:9 thumbnail with a circular play button that opens a placeholder video frame in a native <dialog>.

patterns.name: Customer case-study cards
patterns.description: A three-up grid: wordmark, a headline metric, a one-line summary, an industry chip, and a read-story link.

patterns.name: Trust / guarantee bar
patterns.description: A row of four icon + label reassurances, the kind that sits just beside a final CTA. Static.

patterns.name: Author byline + bio card
patterns.description: A compact byline strip at the top of a post and a fuller author bio card to close it out.

patterns.name: Related articles
patterns.description: A "Read next" grid surfacing three more posts by category, title, and read time.

patterns.name: Reading-progress bar
patterns.description: A progress bar pinned to the top of a scroll container that fills as you read inside the box.

patterns.name: Tag / category filter
patterns.description: A chip row that live-filters the post list below by category.

patterns.name: Trending / most-popular list
patterns.description: A ranked list with oversized numerals and an optional view-count meta line.

patterns.name: Series / chapter nav
patterns.description: A "Part 2 of 5" bar with titled previous/next arrows and a thin progress indicator.

patterns.name: Pull quote
patterns.description: An oversized, offset quote block with a large quotation mark, accent rule, and attribution.

patterns.name: Mega menu
patterns.description: A wide multi-column dropdown for sites with deep navigation, with a CountUp featured card.

patterns.name: Pagination
patterns.description: Numbered page controls with previous / next, an active page, and a truncation gap.

patterns.name: Stepper / wizard progress
patterns.description: A horizontal step indicator for multi-step flows, with completed, current, and upcoming states.

patterns.name: Segmented control
patterns.description: A compact pill toggle for switching between a few mutually exclusive views.

patterns.name: Back-to-top button
patterns.description: A floating control that appears once the user scrolls down, then jumps them back up.

patterns.name: Sticky action bar
patterns.description: A persistent bottom bar pairing a summary with the primary call to action, pinned while content scrolls.

patterns.name: Actions menu
patterns.description: A kebab / overflow menu that reveals contextual actions on click.

patterns.name: Input field library
patterns.description: Text, select, and textarea with label, helper text, and the default / focus / error / disabled states.

patterns.name: Choice controls
patterns.description: Checkboxes, a radio group, and an on/off switch: the three ways to capture a boolean or a pick.

patterns.name: Range & number
patterns.description: A slider with a live value read-out and a stepper number input with − / + controls.

patterns.name: Search with autocomplete
patterns.description: A search input that filters a suggestion list as you type.

patterns.name: Multi-step form
patterns.description: A wizard that advances through panels with Back / Next, keeping the rest hidden.

patterns.name: File upload / dropzone
patterns.description: A drag-and-drop target with a browse fallback and a list of selected files.

patterns.name: Cookie consent
patterns.description: A consent banner with accept / reject and a link to preferences.

patterns.name: Toast notifications
patterns.description: Transient messages that stack in a corner and auto-dismiss.

patterns.name: Alert banners
patterns.description: Inline status messages in four intents: info, success, warning, and error.

patterns.name: Tooltip
patterns.description: A small label that appears on hover or focus to explain a control.

patterns.name: Empty state
patterns.description: Placeholder for no-data views: an icon, a line of guidance, and an action.

patterns.name: Skeleton loader
patterns.description: Shimmering placeholders that mirror the shape of content while it loads.

patterns.name: Spinners & progress
patterns.description: An indeterminate spinner, a determinate bar, and a circular progress ring.

patterns.name: Confirmation dialog
patterns.description: A focused modal that asks the user to confirm a destructive action.

patterns.name: KPI / metric cards
patterns.description: Dashboard stat tiles with a label, a big number, and a trend delta coloured by direction.

patterns.name: Sortable data table
patterns.description: A zebra-striped table with sortable headers. Click a column header to re-sort.

patterns.name: Pricing billing toggle
patterns.description: A monthly / annual switch that swaps the displayed prices in place.

patterns.name: Spec / definition list
patterns.description: A two-column key/value sheet for technical specs, metadata, or property tables.

patterns.name: Horizontal bar chart
patterns.description: A lightweight, CSS-only comparison chart: labelled rows with proportional fills.

patterns.name: Activity feed / timeline
patterns.description: A vertical, dotted timeline of recent events with a relative timestamp and a type tag.

patterns.name: Image carousel
patterns.description: Single-slide carousel with prev / next arrows and dot indicators.

patterns.name: Figure with caption
patterns.description: Image block with a number tag and a typeset caption for docs and case studies.

patterns.name: Video background hero
patterns.description: Full-bleed hero with a looping video or gradient behind a darkening scrim and headline.

patterns.name: Alternating feature row
patterns.description: Classic zig-zag with image and copy swapping sides down the page.

patterns.name: Team / people grid
patterns.description: Grid of people cards with avatar, name, role, and social links.

patterns.name: Responsive embed
patterns.description: Fixed-ratio container for video, maps, or iframes that scales cleanly at any width.

patterns.name: Product card
patterns.description: A shoppable card with image, badge, title, rating, price (with strike-through), and add-to-cart.

patterns.name: Star rating & review
patterns.description: An aggregate rating summary with a distribution breakdown beside an individual review card.

patterns.name: Cart / order summary
patterns.description: A checkout-side summary: line items, a promo field, the totals breakdown, and the pay button.

patterns.name: Filter sidebar
patterns.description: A faceted filter rail: category checkboxes, a price range, and active filter chips you can clear.

patterns.name: Countdown timer
patterns.description: An urgency timer for sales and launches, ticking down in days / hours / minutes / seconds.

patterns.name: Avatar group & social proof
patterns.description: Stacked, overlapping avatars with an overflow count, the "join 2,000+ others" cue.

patterns.name: Collection hero
patterns.description: The top of a category page: breadcrumb, collection title, item count and a short intro, over a tinted band.

patterns.name: Product grid
patterns.description: A responsive 4-up grid of product cards that drops to 2-up on a tablet and 1-up on a phone.

patterns.name: Product card states
patterns.description: The four states one card has to cover side by side: default, on sale with a strike-through RRP and discount badge, sold out, and low stock. T260 on pages/commerce.html is the original single product card.

patterns.name: Product list row
patterns.description: The horizontal alternative to a card, for list-view toggles and search results: thumb left, details centre, price and CTA right.

patterns.name: Sort and result bar
patterns.description: The strip above the grid: result count, a sort select, and a grid or list view toggle.

patterns.name: Filter rail
patterns.description: The desktop faceted sidebar: collapsible details groups, checkbox facets with counts, colour swatches, a price min and max pair, and a clear-all.

patterns.name: Filter drawer
patterns.description: The mobile equivalent of the rail on a native dialog: a trigger with a count, a slide-in panel, then apply or clear.

patterns.name: Active filter chips
patterns.description: A row of removable chips showing what is narrowing the results, each with its own remove control, plus a clear-all.

patterns.name: Quick view modal
patterns.description: A dialog with product image, title, price, variant row, quantity stepper and add-to-cart, opened from a card overlay button.

patterns.name: Load more and pagination
patterns.description: Both ways to reach page two: a load-more button with a showing 24 of 96 progress line, and a numbered pagination row beneath it.

patterns.name: Empty results state
patterns.description: The no-results panel: icon, headline, explanation, the filters worth removing, and a browse-all CTA.

patterns.name: Category tiles
patterns.description: A grid of collection tiles on a wash background with a label and an item count, for a shop landing page.

patterns.name: Product gallery
patterns.description: A main image with a thumbnail rail, a zoom affordance and an image counter, where clicking a thumb swaps the main image.

patterns.name: Buy box
patterns.description: The full right-hand column: eyebrow, title, star rating with a review link, price, short description, add to cart, and a save action.

patterns.name: Variant selector
patterns.description: Colour swatches and size pills as keyboard operable radio groups, with selected, unavailable and sold out states kept distinct.

patterns.name: Quantity stepper
patterns.description: Minus and plus either side of a number input, floored at 1 and capped at the order limit, with a disabled state at each bound.

patterns.name: Price block
patterns.description: Every price presentation in one block: single, sale against RRP with a percent off badge, per unit, from price, and instalments.

patterns.name: Stock and urgency
patterns.description: The availability cues: in stock, low stock with a count and a bar, sold out with a notify action, and a live viewing count.

patterns.name: Delivery estimator
patterns.description: A postcode check that returns a delivery window and a shipping cost, with both a result state and an error state.

patterns.name: Sticky add to cart bar
patterns.description: The bar that slides in once the buy box scrolls away, carrying thumb, title, variant summary, price and an add button.

patterns.name: Product accordion
patterns.description: Description, specifications, shipping and returns as native details disclosures with an animated chevron marker.

patterns.name: Guarantee row
patterns.description: A four up row of icon, label and one line of reassurance for shipping, returns, warranty and secure payment.

patterns.name: Bundle and save
patterns.description: Three products bought together at a combined price, with a checkbox per item that recalculates the total, the saving and the button.

patterns.name: Cross sell rail
patterns.description: A horizontally scrollable goes well with rail of compact product cards, each carrying a quick add button.

patterns.name: Specification table
patterns.description: A two column specification table with a size guide link that opens a dialog holding the measurements table.

patterns.name: Cart drawer
patterns.description: A slide-over cart panel with a close button, line items, subtotal, free-shipping progress, and the view-cart and checkout actions.

patterns.name: Cart line item
patterns.description: One cart row: thumb, title, variant summary, quantity stepper, line total, remove, plus the saved-for-later variant.

patterns.name: Empty cart
patterns.description: The zero state with icon, headline, a line of copy, a browse CTA, and a recently-viewed suggestion row.

patterns.name: Cart page
patterns.description: The full two-column cart: editable line items on the left, a sticky order summary card on the right.

patterns.name: Discount code
patterns.description: A code field with an apply button in three states: idle, applied as a removable chip with the saving shown, and rejected with an inline error.

patterns.name: Free shipping progress
patterns.description: A progress bar counting a subtotal toward the free-shipping threshold, with its unlocked state.

patterns.name: Checkout stepper
patterns.description: A four-step progress indicator for cart, details, shipping and payment, with complete, current and upcoming states.

patterns.name: Contact and delivery form
patterns.description: Email, phone and a full Australian address block with a state select and four-digit postcode, showing the valid and invalid states.

patterns.name: Shipping method selector
patterns.description: Radio cards carrying method name, delivery window and price, including a free option, a selected state and a disabled one.

patterns.name: Payment section
patterns.description: A payment method radio group for card, PayPal and Afterpay, where the card fields reveal for the card option, with a security note.

patterns.name: Express checkout row
patterns.description: A row of express wallet buttons above the divider that hands off to the full checkout form.

patterns.name: Order review
patterns.description: The final confirm panel: every earlier step collapsed with edit links, the totals breakdown, terms consent, and the place-order button.

patterns.name: Order confirmation
patterns.description: The success state with order number, itemised recap, delivery address, estimated arrival, and next-step actions.

patterns.name: Order tracking
patterns.description: A vertical timeline from placed to delivered, carrying the tracking number and marking the parcel's current position.

patterns.name: Announcement bar
patterns.description: A full-width top strip carrying one shipping or offer message, with an optional link and a dismiss button.

patterns.name: Promo banner
patterns.description: A larger dismissible in-page banner: headline, supporting line and one call to action on a wash background.

patterns.name: Countdown offer strip
patterns.description: An offer message wired to a live ticking countdown in days, hours, minutes and seconds, plus its expired state.

patterns.name: Value proposition strip
patterns.description: A four-up icon row for the promises a store repeats sitewide: delivery, returns, payment and support.

patterns.name: Review summary
patterns.description: Average score, star row, total count and a five-bar distribution with percentages, beside a write-a-review call to action.

patterns.name: Review list
patterns.description: Individual reviews with author, verified-buyer badge, date, rating, title, body, purchased variant, customer photos and a helpful counter.

patterns.name: Write a review form
patterns.description: A keyboard-operable star input built from radios, with title, body, a photo upload control and a consent checkbox.

patterns.name: Customer photo gallery
patterns.description: A user-generated photo grid where each tile shows a customer handle and a shop-this-look tag, opening in a dialog lightbox.

patterns.name: Trust and payment row
patterns.description: Accepted payment methods drawn as neutral wordmark labels, beside the security and business reassurances.

patterns.name: Gift options
patterns.description: A gift-wrap toggle with its price, a gift message with a character counter, and a hide-prices-on-the-packing-slip checkbox.

patterns.name: Back in stock
patterns.description: An out-of-stock notice with an email capture, its success state, and a line explaining what the alert does.

patterns.name: Newsletter capture with incentive
patterns.description: An offer headline, email field and consent line, swapping to a success state that reveals a discount code with a copy button.

patterns.name: Recently viewed rail
patterns.description: A compact horizontally scrollable rail of previously viewed products, with a clear-history action and an empty state.

patterns.name: Editorial band
patterns.description: A lookbook band for a story-led store: large image wash, eyebrow, headline, paragraph and a shop-the-story call to action.

patterns.name: Account shell
patterns.description: The signed-in frame: a section nav, a greeting header and a content pane, collapsing to a horizontal scroll nav on narrow widths.

patterns.name: Order history
patterns.description: Past orders as rows with order number, date, item thumbs, a status pill, the total and per-order actions.

patterns.name: Order detail
patterns.description: One order opened out: status, itemised lines, delivery address, payment summary, totals, and invoice, reorder and support actions.

patterns.name: Return request
patterns.description: A returns flow with per-item reasons, a refund or exchange choice, a comments field and a live summary of the refund.

patterns.name: Wishlist
patterns.description: Saved products with price, an availability line, move to cart and remove, plus the empty state when the last one goes.

patterns.name: Address book
patterns.description: Saved address cards with a default badge, edit and delete on an inline confirm, and an add-address form revealed by a button.

patterns.name: Payment methods
patterns.description: Saved card rows showing brand, masked last four, expiry, a default badge and an expired state, with an add-card form.

patterns.name: Subscription manager
patterns.description: An active subscription with a frequency select that moves the next delivery date, plus skip, pause and cancel.

patterns.name: Rewards panel
patterns.description: A points balance, a progress bar to the next tier, a redeem row that spends the balance, and a short points ledger.

patterns.name: Sign in and register
patterns.description: A two-tab panel with sign in on one tab and create account on the other, a forgot-password link and a guest option.

patterns.name: Password reset
patterns.description: The request form with its check-your-email confirmation, and a set-new-password form with a strength meter and match check.

patterns.name: Guest order lookup
patterns.description: An order number plus email form for customers without an account, with a found result and a not-found error state.
